sentry-list-organizations.name: sentry-list-organizations
sentry-list-organizations.description: List all organizations the authenticated user has access to

sentry-list-projects.name: sentry-list-projects
sentry-list-projects.description: List all projects in an organization

params.organization: Organization slug (e.g., 'my-org'). Optional if configured in credentials.

sentry-list-issues.name: sentry-list-issues
sentry-list-issues.description: List issues (errors/problems) for a project. Can filter by status and query.

params.organization: Organization slug. Optional if configured in credentials.
params.project: Project slug (optional, lists all if not provided)
params.limit: Maximum number of issues to return (default: 25)

sentry-get-issue.name: sentry-get-issue
sentry-get-issue.description: Get detailed information about a specific issue

sentry-list-events.name: sentry-list-events
sentry-list-events.description: List events (individual error occurrences) for an issue

params.issueId: The issue ID to get events for
params.limit: Maximum number of events to return (default: 25)

sentry-get-event.name: sentry-get-event
sentry-get-event.description: Get detailed information about a specific event including full stack trace

params.organization: Organization slug. Optional if configured in credentials.

name: Sentry Error Monitoring
description: Monitor errors, issues, and performance in your applications using Sentry API. List projects, view issues, and manage error states.

changelog.notes: Initial release — browse projects, track error issues with stack traces, and resolve or mute alerts
